findings.desc: verificationEvidence covers every CHK-001/002/003 happy-edge-adversarial lane, and packages/main npm run test:flow-stability-smoke passes at HEAD f0ad19821891b32b68d35aa5a1b0b1fd3fedeec0; however the recorded command is underspecified because npm run test:flow-stability-smoke fails from the story worktree root with Missing script and only reproduces from packages/main.

CHK-001 userSees says the user can run koala session_brief in REVIEW, but the actual global koala entrypoint still fails in this worktree: `koala session_brief` returns "命令 \"session_brief\" 在 REVIEW 阶段不可用" while `node packages/main/dist/cli.js session_brief` and `node dist/cli.js session_brief` both pass. The current smoke/evidence only covers the package-local build, so it misses the real user-facing executable path.

packages/main/src/handlers/worktree.ts:76-77 unlinks the global @koala-agent/core symlink before creating the replacement, and packages/main/src/handlers/story-advance.ts:989-997 catches relink failure but still removes the worktree. If symlink creation fails, DONE can still break the global koala command, which contradicts CHK-003’s promise to preserve the usable CLI or only skip safely.

quality reviewer finding: if global @koala-agent/core symlink points into the story worktree and relink throws, story-advance currently records only a warning and still removes the worktree, which can leave the user-facing koala command broken after DONE cleanup.

test-coverage reviewer clean: current HEAD passes cd packages/main && npm run test:flow-stability-smoke, including coverage for session_brief all-phase gate, opt-in reviewer REVIEW gate, and global koala relink failure blocking worktree deletion.
